(Japanese: '''最高潮始動！サトシのマスターズトーナメント！！''' ''The Climax Begins! {{tt|Satoshi|Ash}}'s {{tt|Masters Tournament|Masters Eight Tournament}} Experience!!'') is the 121st episode of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', and the 1,206th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on August 12, 2022.
{{spoilers}}

==Plot==
The "[[World Coronation Series|Pokémon World Coronation Series]] News" covers the events of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]] so far, recapping the quarterfinals matches and providing an analysis of the semifinalists: {{an|Leon}}, [[Diantha]], {{an|Cynthia}}, and {{Ash}}. Following the in-depth analysis, the program lists the most shocking moments in Ash's World Coronation Series battles so far: the {{m|Iron Tail}}-{{m|Quick Attack}} combo that his {{AP|Pikachu}} used during [[JN086|his Ultra Class battle]] against [[Bea]]; his {{AP|Dragonite}} transforming {{TP|Iris|Haxorus}}'s {{m|Dragon Pulse}} into {{m|Draco Meteor}} during [[JN065|his match]] against {{an|Iris}}; and the giant {{m|Aura Sphere}} that his {{AP|Lucario}} used to defeat [[Raihan]]'s [[Gigantamax]] {{p|Duraludon}} during [[JN109|his entrance battle]].

The [[narrator]], hosting a radio show, reads listener mail. The first letter is from [[Allister]], which leads to a recap of how [[JN016|Ash first befriended]] his {{AP|Gengar}}. The second letter comes from [[Wikstrom]], leading to a recap of how Ash's {{p|Farfetch'd}} [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{AP|Sirfetch'd}} during [[JN060|his battle]] with [[Rinto]] and his {{p|Gallade}}. The [[clip show]] ends with a storybook tale told by {{AP|Dracovish}}, telling how it woke up in a strange world after sleeping for a long time, but came to like the friends it made and things it could bite on in this new world.

==Trivia==
[[File:JN121 AS.png|thumb|150px|The "[[After the Story]]" artwork for this episode]]
* The [[narrator]] reads the [[title card]] for this episode.
* Like the [[JN119|last]] clip show episode, no main character is physically present.
** At three episodes, this episode marks the longest period Ash and Pikachu do not physically appear in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during their time as protagonists.
** This makes it the third numbered episode in a row to not feature any main characters in person.
* This is the first time that two {{DL|Clip show|regular broadcasting clip shows}} have aired in the same [[series]] since ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''.
** Also, at two weeks, this episode marks the shortest period between the airing of clip shows in a same series.
* [[James]], {{MTR}}, [[Jessie]], and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} narrate the preview for the [[JN122|next episode]].
** A special preview regarding the last semifinal match of the [[Masters Eight Tournament]], Ash versus {{an|Cynthia}}, was aired after the episode.
* As a clip show, this episode was not dubbed into any other language, and was not aired anywhere outside of Japan and South Korea.
